about_the_game:
Naked Yoga - Vinyasa in the nude

Naked Yoga is a physics-driven puzzle game where you guide your yogi through increasingly challenging vinyasa flows. Position your hands and feet with precision, maintain balance, and time your breathing to complete each sequence. Train your yogi to improve their practice, leveling up strength and flexibility in each limb. Earn points to unlock new environments, yoga mats, hairstyles, customization options, and sexy wearable accessories for your sessions.

Key Features:

  • Naked Yogis: In naked yoga, yogis can practice yoga naked. Switch camera angles and get a good view of the yoga action.

  • Realistic Physics: In naked yoga the bodies respond realistically to physics. Whether it’s the softbody physics of the boobs or penises or the ragdoll physics when a yogi loses balance; exquisite attention has been paid to realistic physics interactions. 

  • Character Progression: Build strength and flexibility in individual limbs to get better at the yoga poses and even unlock new ones. 

  • Relaxing and Sensual: Soothing ambient soundscapes combined with beautiful naked yogis relieve stress and get you in a calm head space.

  • Vinyasa Flow Sequences: Learn and complete authentic yoga sequences, from Sun Salutation to Warrior poses

Part yoga simulator, part physics challenge, part anatomy lesson. Will you achieve zen mastery or become one with the floor?

content_descriptors.notes: The base game does not contain mature content. However, the nudity DLC unlocks the ability to perform yoga naked.
